home_idle: Nothing is being sent right now.
no_recipients: There is nobody to send to in this audience yet.
pick_mode: 📣 Audience: {audience} How should it be sent? 📋 Copy — sent as Aegis's own message (no “Forwarded from”); you can add link buttons. ↪️ Forward — shows “Forwarded from” and the original sender; Telegram doesn't allow adding buttons to a forward.
send_prompt: ✍️ Send the message to broadcast to {audience} ({mode}). Text, photo, video, file, GIF, audio or voice — with its caption and formatting. To reuse a post with link buttons, forward it here: its URL buttons are kept. Albums aren't supported: send one message.
album_unsupported: ⚠️ Albums can't be broadcast as one message. Send a single photo, video or file.
unsupported: ⚠️ This kind of message can't be broadcast. Send text, a photo, a video or a file.
not_draft: ℹ️ This broadcast was already sent or discarded.
buttons_help: 🔗 Link buttons Send one line per row; separate buttons in a row with |; each button is Text - link: Our channel - https://t.me/example Rules - https://t.me/example/5 | Site - https://example.com At most 8 rows and 4 buttons per row.
buttons_err_too_many_in_row: ❌ Line {line} has too many buttons: at most 4 per row.
buttons_err_text: ❌ Line {line}: a button's text is empty or too long (48 characters max).
buttons_err_url: ❌ Line {line}: the link must start with https://, http://, tg:// or t.me/.
confirm_title: 👆 Preview of broadcast #{id} (exactly what recipients will get)
confirm_forward_note: ↪️ Forwarded messages can't get extra buttons.
cant_copy: ❌ Telegram couldn't copy that message. Try another message.
progress_hint: Telegram Serverless has no background timer, so sending moves forward when you press «Send next batch», while the live page is open, and a little with every message the bot receives.
progress_queued_hint: It starts automatically when the current broadcast ends.
paused_source_gone: ⏸ Paused: the original message was deleted from this chat, so Telegram can't copy it any more. Cancel and create a new broadcast.
cancel_q:
⛔️ Cancel broadcast #{id}?
Messages already sent stay; nobody else gets it.
queued_toast: 🕒 Queued: it starts when the current broadcast ends.
toast_locked: ⏳ A batch is being sent right now.
